entities.summary: Joseph Thuney is an American professional football guard for the Chicago Bears of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the NC State Wolfpack. He was selected by the New England Patriots in the third round in the 2016 NFL draft. Thuney is the first player in NFL history to start in the Super Bowl in each of his first three seasons.
